notes: Read SKILL.md, CHANGELOG.md, references/skill-feedback.md and assets/feedback-issue-template.md in full. Official Supabase umbrella skill: verify against current changelog/docs, an RLS/auth/storage security checklist, CLI and MCP troubleshooting, schema-change workflow (declarative vs imperative migrations) and debugging guidance.

Medium because it directs the agent to fetch supabase.com docs and changelog over the network (SKILL.md:16, 76, 122, 150), run the Supabase CLI against the user's project (db query, db advisors, db pull --yes, migration new), execute SQL via MCP execute_sql, curl the MCP endpoint for a status code (SKILL.md:104), create .mcp.json (SKILL.md:108), and use scoped personal access tokens. Acceptable: all of it targets the user's own Supabase project for the task they asked for, it pushes toward least-privilege scoped tokens and away from SECURITY DEFINER/service_role exposure, and nothing pipes remote scripts to a shell or prints secrets.

Feedback flow (references/skill-feedback.md) only runs when the user reports bad skill guidance and step 1 asks the user's permission before creating a GitHub issue on supabase/agent-skills; that is user-initiated and confirmed, so acceptable. Its ../assets/feedback-issue-template.md link resolves inside the skill directory. Front matter says version 0.1.2 while CHANGELOG.md runs to 0.1.9 (and repeats entries across releases); cosmetic only. The HTML comments in the issue template are placeholder hints, not instructions.
